Remote work download dependencies
=================================

client-zip 2.5.0
Author: David Junger
Project: https://github.com/Touffy/client-zip
Vendored distribution: https://unpkg.com/client-zip@2.5.0/index.js
Local module: ../js/vendor/client-zip-2.5.0.mjs
Local SHA-256 (including final newline):
8168da2ee05a4e81830c30e088dc44bdd4adb84ef93a8b1327730ed7a93a6e4f
License: MIT; full text in client-zip-LICENSE.txt next to this notice.
The distribution is stored locally and is never loaded from a CDN at runtime.

The same-origin download response design was informed by the documented
ServiceWorker download technique in StreamSaver.js:
https://github.com/jimmywarting/StreamSaver.js
No StreamSaver source is included; no external middleman page, worker,
extension, hosted proxy, account or local helper is used by this module.

The application download-worker.mjs, stream-download.mjs and work-zip.mjs are
project code. ZIP64 streaming generation is provided by client-zip. The
bounded compatibility ZIP32 writer is project code and emits stored entries.
